name: easyeda-pro-control
description: Safety-gated EasyEDA engineering skills, offline SDK reference, typed API editing, native control and verified recovery.

interface.longDescription: Seven EasyEDA engineering skills cover live control, schematic design, PCB layout, component libraries, manufacturing release, design review and extension development. The authenticated facade exposes offline reviewed/latest SDK declarations, exact operation schemas and argument validation alongside typed API edits, exact readers, native dialogs, checkpoints and recovery. The reviewed external tuple is connected-read-admitted; future mismatches fail closed. Writes require exact authority, source/connectivity and complete durable proof. Save and uncertain calls are never blindly retried. SDK declarations are documentation, not execution permission; coverage and live validation remain operation-specific, and historical tests do not validate this facade generation. Raw JavaScript is refused and the legacy writer is runtime-disabled.
defaultPrompt: Validate the EasyEDA bridge without bypassing compatibility gates.
Inspect the admitted EasyEDA project with exact readers and managed evidence.
Apply the requested typed design change and verify it after saving and reopening.
